title: Austin’s Original Graffiti Culture Experience & Workshop
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: This experience takes place both indoors and outdoors, please dress for your comfort.
Private bookings can be tailored for design teams seeking cultural immersion, active bachelorette parties, or families seeking creative inspiration and youthful fun.
Great for groups, teams, and team-building experiences
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Immerse yourself into the vibrant world of graffiti and paint with a local artist!

Learn about graffiti writer's motives, techniques, and etiquette from one Austin's most prominent local graffiti artists. We have a range of knowledge about graffiti world so be vocal about your curiosities!

Bar and refreshments available. 

To top off your experience, YOU will learn the foundational techniques to leave your mark on Austin’s graffiti scene from an authentic graffiti writer as you spray paint a wall — with permission. During this portion of the experience, your host will demonstrate their craft by personalizing a shirt or tote bag for each guest.

Tour is 90 minutes (2 - 45 min. Sections)
